English: Root Cellar
A shallow, hand-dug pit lined with brush and timber, used to keep grain safe from weather and rot in the open steppe.
Earthen Pit
A deeper, reinforced pit with straw insulation, allowing for larger and safer storage of harvested grains.
Wattle Storage Shed
A simple above-ground shed of woven wattle and daub, providing better protection from animals and damp.
Thatched Granary
A sturdy, thatch-roofed granary raised on posts, keeping grain dry and safe from pests and floods.
Rodent-Proof Silo
A sealed, timber-walled storage with stone foundations, designed specifically to keep out rodents and birds.
Guarded Grain Pavilion
A fortified pavilion with watch posts and guards, ensuring the security of the clans vital grain stores during migration and war.
Timber Storage Hall
A large wooden hall, with raised platforms and ventilation, allowing storage of vast quantities of grain for entire clans.
Expanded Granary
A sprawling complex of interconnected timber buildings for storing and sorting grain, with space for seasonal surpluses and emergencies.
Grain Exchange Room
A central exchange for the storage and trade of grain between clans, boosting both supply and economic influence.
Slavic Grand Granary
A monumental grain complex, symbol of the clans prosperity and unity, with tall towers, stone foundations, and administrative offices.
